note: City of O'Neill campground in Carney Park, a row of back-in water-and-electric pads along the park's north drive, backed by trees (20/30-amp, some 30/50). Restrooms and hot showers near the pads (seasonal). First come, self-serve payment envelopes; stays over 7 days pre-register at the city office. A 3-acre fishing pond, rodeo arena, ball fields and horseshoe pits in the park. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 18 water+electric spaces, showers near the pads, RV $20.00 a day, 7-day pre-registration rule; fees/sites/facilities upgraded to manual, hookups water manual. Phone (402) 336-3640 (city office) to add. Waterfront pond -> not waterfront: the ~2.7-acre pond (city: three acres) is ~350 m south of the pads beyond the rodeo arena and ball fields. Pin ~200 m west of the pad row (at the park entrance); optional move.
flags: PHONE missing: add the City of O'Neill office (402) 336-3640 (parks page: 'contacting the City of O'Neill's administrative office located at 401 East Fremont or call (402) 336-3640').

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored 'pond' -> not waterfront): the city calls it 'a three acre fishing pond' (flood-fill on imagery ~2.7 acres at 42.4488,-98.6460), under the ~5-acre line, and it lies ~350 m south of the RV pads with the rodeo arena, ball fields and park drives between. The Elkhorn River is ~700 m south. No pond-view value exists: not waterfront.
PIN: stored 42.45132,-98.64726 is at the park entrance on US-281; the pad row is ~200 m east along the north drive, centred about 42.4514,-98.6448. Under the 250 m line; move if wanted.
Not re-confirmed by the city page (left as stored): the amperage mix (electric 50), ~40-ft back-in length, self-serve envelopes and 'seasonal' showers.
